title: Where One Path Finally Won

features.name: the settled signpost
features.desc-on-touch: a marker that once pointed two ways but now has lost one arm—not rotted off, but chosen away. the remaining direction is so firmly fixed that it has begun to take root

features.name: the settlement that answered
features.desc-on-touch: a small cluster of forms—houses, a store, a payphone that no longer dials—all facing the direction chosen. built in the shadow of the choice, still keeping the other path's ghost in peripheral memory

features.name: the empty arch where the other path was
features.desc-on-touch: an opening in space where routes could branch, but now stands empty. not ruined—sealed. the decision made this emptiness permanent, and something about it resonates like a tuning fork

features.name: the memory-ground of what was chosen away
features.desc-on-touch: beneath the settled path, a faint glyphic trace—like a watermark in stone—that names the path not taken. the earth still remembers both, even though the sky chose one

inscription: the path that won did not forget that it had a twin—it simply became the only one permitted to speak aloud
